players.product: Helios AI/HPC data-center campus (West Texas, 800 gross MW) leased to CoreWeave, plus Merlin / Caspian / Selene Texas development sites - ex-Bitcoin-mining site (Galaxy Power)

connects_to.relationship: Helios campus (West Texas) AI data-center capacity leased to CoreWeave - 800 gross MW across three phases (Phase I 133 MW critical IT delivered; Phase II 260 MW; Phase III 133 MW)

contracts.signal: Galaxy's prospectus states that in March 2025 it entered into a 15-year Lease Agreement with CoreWeave to host CoreWeave's AI and HPC infrastructure and deliver 133 MW of critical IT load (utilizing 200 MW of gross power capacity) at the Helios campus, and that on April 1, 2025 the parties entered into a Phase II Option Agreement under which CoreWeave committed to enter into a lease for an additional 260 MW of critical IT load (utilizing 400 MW of gross power) starting in 2027, on substantially similar economic terms as the phase I lease, bringing total committed critical IT capacity at Helios to 393 MW utilizing 600 MW of gross power. Galaxy said it expected its AI/HPC data center business to initially be highly dependent on a single customer, CoreWeave, and the full 133 MW of initial critical IT load to be delivered by the end of the first half of 2026.
contracts.units: 393 MW critical IT load committed (133 MW Lease Agreement + 260 MW Phase II); 600 MW gross power
contracts.date_signed: March 2025 (Lease Agreement); April 1, 2025 (Phase II Option Agreement)
